description: This file defines extension methods for the NodeAppModel class, focusing on normalizing watch notification parameters, actions, risk levels, and priorities. It contains utility functions to clean and standardize input data related to watch notifications within the app's notification system.

methods.name: normalizeWatchNotifyParams
methods.description: Normalizes and sanitizes the input parameters for watch notifications, adjusting text, trimming values, and normalizing nested properties.

methods.name: normalizeWatchActions
methods.description: Creates a list of normalized watch actions based on provided actions, or automatically generates default actions based on the notification kind and prompt ID.

methods.name: normalizedWatchRisk
methods.description: Determines the normalized watch risk level based on the provided risk or inferred from the priority.

methods.name: normalizedWatchPriority
methods.description: Determines the normalized notification priority based on the provided priority or inferred from the risk.

methods.name: trimmedOrNil
methods.description: Utility function to trim whitespace from a string or return nil if the string is empty.
